text_block_list.text:
Shoelaces are tied tight. And I drank my 
special apple juice before heading out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I trained thoroughly too, so I should be 
able to win this time...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I've done everything I could...! No, 
but what if I overlooked something—
choice_data_list: Don't forget to stay calm, either.
Don't forget to take a breather, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I love taking detours, but races are a 
different story! I'm aiming only for 1st 
place—here I go!
